//Sandbox: The isolation layer: which backend, which image, and the per-profile caps. Switch Backend to 'kubernetes' to run this same sample against a cluster.
//SandboxAgentHost: How a run dials back here, and which credentials to seed. BackendUrl/GrpcBackendUrl must be reachable FROM INSIDE the container — the host.docker.internal defaults work with AddHostGateway on Docker Desktop and Linux.

SandboxAgentHost.//creds: Optional. Point these at host paths to authenticate the in-container CLI (else the agent turn can't run). Each is mounted RO at /seed and copied into HOME by the entrypoint. e.g. ClaudeConfigHostDir=~/.claude, ClaudeConfigJsonHostFile=~/.claude.json.
